description: LUMIX Camera Settings .DAT/.CAM Complete Structural Analysis

failed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypothesis 1: The entire payload is a uniform small TLV stream (2-byte Tag + 2-byte Len).
failed_hypotheses.falsified_by: Parser halts at byte 26,165 (0x6635) when encountering tag 0x0351, achieving only ~1.16% coverage. The stream actually interleaves Small Records (w1 != 0, length in uint16) and Large Records (w1 == 0, length in uint32 at offset+4) with 4-byte alignment padding.

failed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypothesis 2: The entire file is composed of 14-mode identical parallel arrays.
failed_hypotheses.falsified_by: While 507 small records contain 14-byte or 28-byte (14x uint16) mode-specific arrays, Tag 0x0520 is a massive 2,156,292-byte container holding 10 reserved custom slots (215,628 bytes stride), and the tail section contains variable-length single-value configurations and model-specific entries (such as S5IIX streaming/SSD records).
failed_hypotheses.status: Partially true for front-end small tags, completely false for macro structure

failed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypothesis 3: Payload is encrypted with AES/DES or compressed with zlib/gzip.
failed_hypotheses.falsified_by: Full-file Shannon entropy is only 0.188, with 98.26% sparse zero padding. Non-zero configuration payload is only ~39 KB (1.73%), stored as structured plain binary integers and ASCII strings.

failed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypothesis 4: File integrity is protected by CRC32, Adler32, MD5, or proprietary RSA signature.
failed_hypotheses.falsified_by: No CRC32/Adler32 candidates hit. The actual verification is an 8-bit Two's Complement Checksum at the very last byte (offset total_len - 1), preceded by sentinel 0xFFFF0000. Verified across all 4 sample versions: sum(all_bytes) % 256 == 0 exactly.
failed_hypotheses.status: Disproven CRC hypothesis; proven 8-bit Two's Complement Checksum

failed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypothesis 5: Guessing High Resolution ON/OFF and Mechanical Shutter semantic tags from single-sample values.
failed_hypotheses.falsified_by: Rejected on rigorous methodological grounds. Single sample values (e.g. 0x01 or 0x00) appear hundreds of times across 966 tags. Without a single-variable controlled sample (A/B diff with only High-Res or Shutter toggled), attributing semantics to arbitrary tags constitutes fabricated evidence.

findings.size_invariance: Files from 2025 and 2026 retain exact identical byte sizes: S5II = 2,252,861 bytes, S5IIX = 2,253,165 bytes.
findings.checksum_invariance: All 4 files (old S5II, new S5II, old S5IIX, new S5IIX) satisfy sum(bytes) % 256 == 0 perfectly.
findings.single_variable_status: The repository preset updates represent macro production presets (video modes, custom buttons, audio levels), not single-variable laboratory captures for High-Res or Mechanical Shutter.

shutter_angle_field.evidence: Value 0x00b4 (= 180 decimal), corresponding exactly to the documented 180.0-degree video shutter angle recommended by Vanier College multimedia handbook.

model_identity_field.evidence: Offset 58 contains 14 repeated uint16 values: 0x004a ('J' = S5II) in S5II, and 0x004b ('K' = S5IIX) in S5IIX.

s5iix_exclusive_extension_block.evidence: Accounts for 100% of the byte difference between S5II and S5IIX (2,253,165 - 2,252,861 = 304 bytes). Matches S5IIX hardware features (USB-SSD, ProRes, IP streaming, HDMI RAW).

highres_and_shutter_type_status.official_manual_confirmation: Manual DVQP2839 (0148.html) confirms [High Resolution Mode Setting] and [Shutter Type] are in Save/Restore scope.
highres_and_shutter_type_status.reverse_engineering_conclusion: No tag can be scientifically labeled as 'High Resolution' or 'Mechanical Shutter' without single-variable A/B differential evidence. Attributing semantics based on isolated byte values is strictly rejected to prevent false positive reverse-engineering.
